title: Dual Modulus Prescaler
text: Integer clock divider with two divider ratios, 1 input, 1 output; {Program counter value, P} sets the maximum value of program counter, {Prescaler divider value, N}, {Swallow counter value, S} sets the maximum value of swallow counter, {Enable increased buffer size} and {Buffer size} sets the number of samples of the input buffering available during. Values come from the instance.

params.name: Program counter value, P
params.values: Maximum value of program counter 12 (default) | scalar integer

params.name: Swallow counter value, S
params.values: Maximum value of swallow counter 2 (default) | scalar integer

params.name: Enable increased buffer size
params.values: Enable increased buffer size off (default) | on

params.name: Buffer size
params.values: Number of samples of the input buffering available during simulation 1 (default) | positive integer scalar
